title: Department of Energy holds both UFO secrets and the Human Genome Project

tellings.quote: And while the Department of Energy per the UFO nuclear connection likely holds a lot of secrets when it comes to unidentified flying objects and their reverse engineering, they also conducted the human genome project.

plain: Michels argues that the Department of Energy, because of the long-reported link between UFOs and nuclear sites, likely holds many secrets about UFOs and the reverse engineering of them, meaning taking recovered craft apart to copy how they work, and that the same department also ran the Human Genome Project in the 1990s. He makes this connection himself, in an episode on medical experiments and the drug industry, to suggest that UFO secrecy and human biology research sat under the same roof.
